notes.title: 6th Feb Update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added new music!
[*] Upgraded engine from unity 2020 to unity 6 to allow for future optimisations and features!
[*] Locked fps to users refresh rate and enabled vsync.
[*] Added pause ability (Esc) and countdown on unpausing.
[*] Added simple anticheat to stop people pausing and editing their score.
[*] Added skip track button (N).
[*] Updated games graphics settings some more to reduce anti aliasing settings and HDR effects where it wasn't really providing any benefit.
[*] Fixed some texture issues, e.g. the octane. It had a random white line above the car.
[/list]

As always, visit the discord if you have any support problems or want to support us developing this game :D https://discord.gg/SvzgGrsN5G

notes.title: 4th February 2025 Update!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Rain is now random
[*] Added FPS counter
[*] Set graphics quality to low to support lower end pc's - no real difference to player
[*] Set pipes to delete faster when off screen to reduce resource usage
[*] Added final score, final speed, and total time to game over screen
[*] UI changes to main game score/speed display
[/list]

Once again, join the discord if you have any problems :)

https://discord.gg/SvzgGrsN5G
